title: Weighing the Cargo

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: A ship must be loaded just right: too heavy at one end and she'll tip, too light and she'll bob about.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Would you please weigh the grain for the hold? The beam hangs level when it's just right.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Add scoops of grain until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Add a scoop, or take one out.

feedback.heavy: Too much! Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! That sack's ready for the hold.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: A well-balanced ship sails straight and true. Thank you, shipmate!

journal_line: I weighed grain for the ship's hold with Captain Mara.
